title: Per-hop CompassTrace capture and fallback verification pipeline
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Add a lightweight per-hop capture pipeline ("CompassTrace") that records routing signals used for region selection, tier routing decisions, and fallback model variant selection. The goal is to provide reproducible, low-cost diagnostic traces that can be correlated with latency/cost SLOs and with user-visible anomalies. This ticket covers schema design, sampling policy, storage/retention trade-offs, a proof-of-concept collector + saver, and a canary rollout path behind a feature flag.
acceptance_criteria: Schema for CompassTrace defined and reviewed (fields, versioning, privacy-safe hashes)
Sampling policy implemented with configurable per-customer and per-route rates
Prototype collector deployed to staging capturing sampled per-hop frames without degrading p99 latency >5%
CompassTrace events stored in compressed, queryable format and surfaced in Console debug timeline
Fallback verification tools that replay a sample of traces to validate that fallback variant selection is deterministic for captured context
Runbook updated with steps to enable full-capture for incident timelines and to disable for high-traffic customers
comments: 2026-03-09 - Kickoff: scoped work with PM and Observability PM. Decided to avoid shipping full request bodies — use canonicalized context fingerprints and hashed user ids to stay within privacy/KYC constraints. Action: design schema by 2026-03-11. (Ava)

2026-03-11 - Schema PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/412 — includes fields: timestamp, route_id, region_hint, tier_decision, fallback_variant, decision_score_vector (quantized), context_hash, sampled_frame_id. Seeking review from infra and security. (Priya)
2026-03-11 - Security review comment: ensure context_hash is salted per-tenant and retention defaults to 30 days. Blocker: need KMS integration for per-tenant salt rotation. (Maya - Security)

2026-03-12 - Prototype collector (go) demoed in staging; end-to-end runtime overhead measured at +2.8% p99 under synthetic traffic. Observability team requested an additional compacted index for quick lookups by sampled_frame_id. (Ethan)

2026-03-12 - Trade-off note: we debated storing full per-hop reasons vs. an enumerated codebook. Decided on codebook + optional verbose frames captured under 'incident' mode to bound storage costs. (Priya)
2026-03-13 - Blocker logged: EU data-residency customers require traces to remain in eu-west region. Created dependency ENG-95105 to add region-scoped retention placement. (Priya)

2026-03-13 - Next steps: wire Console timeline to show CompassTrace frames, add a replay harness that can feed captured traces into the routing simulator for fallback verification. Plan canary rollout to 5% of requests for internal tenants. (Ava)
